cdn_image_transform_rules.important: Shopify generates these variants on demand and caches them at the edge. The set of 'available' CDN resources is therefore effectively unbounded: any width/height/format combination of any uploaded file is a valid, live URL. The 17-width ladder above is what the Turbo theme actually requests; the underlying uploads are the canonical cdn.shopify.com URLs.
